summary: The exact candidate fully resolves the reported DP=8, TP=1 TCPStore EADDRINUSE contract. It removes TCP rendezvous from each singleton DP scheduler by using HashStore, assigns distinct explicit ports per DP rank, retains automatic non-ephemeral allocation for groups that still need TCPStore, and fails closed when safe allocation cannot be established. The original base failure and all three prior-review counterexamples were independently reproduced before candidate testing.

tests.what_was_measured: A real one-rank Gloo process group attempted TCPStore bind after an independent listener acquired the selected port and failed with DistNetworkError EADDRINUSE.
PortArgs for --nccl-port 30101 and DP ranks 0 through 7 returned [30101, 30101, 30101, 30101, 30101, 30101, 30101, 30101].
The base had no dedicated fail-closed rendezvous allocator.

tests.command: Run occupied_singleton, explicit_dp_ports, and allocator_fail_closed from adversarial_review.py at c26eb16eb26ef1952b1cf882ceeb3521d808854b
tests.what_was_measured: The occupied-port singleton initialized through HashStore; explicit DP ports were 30101 through 30108; missing procfs and exhausted non-ephemeral ranges both raised RuntimeError instead of falling back.
A real one-rank NCCL process group initialized while the advertised TCP port was occupied and completed all_reduce with value 7.0 on cuda:0 backed by AMD gfx950.
41 focused tests passed, covering candidate regressions plus adjacent socket and PortArgs behavior.
262 passed and 2 unrelated tests failed because this ROCm platform intentionally rejects deprecated prefill context parallelism; neither failure touches the candidate diff.
All changed production Python modules compiled successfully.

gpu_evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950). A real NCCL-backend singleton all_reduce completed with result 7.0 while a listener occupied the advertised rendezvous port.
remaining_counterexamples: Outside the original TP=1 topology, multi-rank TP/PP groups still use TCPStore. Selecting a non-ephemeral port prevents the reported OS ephemeral-reuse mechanism but cannot prevent a deliberately competing process from binding during the close-before-TCPStore-bind interval.
remaining_limitations: The prepared machine has one AMD gfx950 GPU with ROCm, not eight NVIDIA H800 GPUs with CUDA.
Qwen3-Embedding weights were not available, so the exact eight-GPU model-serving launch was not run.
The deterministic singleton process-group and PortArgs probes cover the reported DP=8, TP=1 contract but do not qualify other model architectures or multi-node behavior.
No native source changed in the candidate; a native rebuild was not applicable.
